out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIUM COMPOUND, test kit. test kit was provided diuring the inspection.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device Used to Check Sanitizer Conc
violations.observation: The operator is not testing the chemical sanitizing solution to ensure proper concentration of the solution because a test kit could not be provided during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: The operator shall be monitoring the concentration of the sanitizing solution using a test kit or other device. CORRECTED, DURING THE INSPECTION.
